notes.title: NEW UPDATES and a few features
notes.content:
[list]
Updating undo/redo buttons to work with fixing placement errors from user or change of mind errors. Limited to 4 memory changes at the moment. 
Updated camera rotations to sync when toggled. Added visual grid for placement that affects the distance of objects placed. Works both 3d and 2d. 
Increased performance, capped FPS with no Vsync, Added 3D placement of objects, limited/controlled camera views for related actions, Added new camera for marble views, and more...
[/list]
